scope: Observed F48 victory -> F49 only; six already-studied ended runs, not independent calibration or general two-battle API

observation_labels.first_post_victory: First indexed noncombat snapshot after the winning combat; direct post-victory persistent resources
observation_labels.first_exit: Last noncombat snapshot before F49 (usually MAP); keep distinct from immediate victory and rewards
observation_labels.first_last_combat: Last logged combat frame; not necessarily a terminal frame
observation_labels.second_first_actionable: First indexed ready T1; not certified untouched opening

hp.rule: Use actual post-victory and next actionable HP separately; no generic act-transition heal inferred.

max_hp_deck_relics_potions.rule: Carry actual persistent state, account separately for rewards and opening triggers; use the per-run snapshots, never refill consumed potions.

combat_state.rule: Previous combat powers/piles are not a confirmed persistent resource. Listed disappearance is evidence only for observed powers; new opening triggers require current-state observation.

next_identity.rule: Read actual F49 combat enemy; prior act boss metadata alone is insufficient.

joint_win_probability.reason: No calibrated joint endpoint distribution; mean exit HP and four-run double-boss curve do not establish joint win probability.
